Future<void> run(items, read) async {
 final a = [0, for (final item in items)
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await read(item)];
 final b = [for (final item in items)
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await read(item), 0];
 final c = {0: 0, for (final item in items) item:
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await read(item)};
}
